name: CSL-Daily
description: A large-scale continuous Chinese Sign Language translation dataset featuring daily-life topics, with spoken-language translations and gloss-level annotations.
citation: Hao Zhou, Wengang Zhou, Weizhen Qi, Junfu Pu, and Houqiang Li. Improving Sign Language Translation with Monolingual Data by Sign Back-Translation. CVPR 2021. https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.12397
